baslik: How a Single Step Triggers an Avalanche
aciklama:
An avalanche can be triggered by one footstep and move faster than a car. Here is the hidden science under the snow.

#shorts #science #avalanche #nature #howitworks

sahneler.metin: An avalanche can start with a single footstep.
Snow falls in layers over a whole winter.
Buried between them can be a weak, sugary layer of crystals.
It holds a heavy slab of snow like a house of cards.
One extra load - new snow, or a skier - snaps that bond.
The whole slab releases at once and starts to slide.
It picks up snow and speed, hitting eighty miles an hour.
Slopes around thirty eight degrees are the most dangerous.
The mountain looked perfectly calm - until it moved.
